exposure: Distance between internal os and placental edge (IO-PE)
Distance between external os and placental edge (EO-PE)
outcome: Diagnostic utility of EO-PE for low-lying placenta
cohort: The study included 94 uncomplicated singleton pregnant women with cephalic presentation and a posterior low-lying placenta, diagnosed as the distance between the internal os and placental edge of 0-3.0 cm at 34-36 weeks' gestation.
finding: The EO-PE distance remained unchanged after 31-33 weeks' gestation, unlike the cervical length and IO-PE distance, suggesting it is a promising and stable parameter for diagnosing low-lying placenta in the third trimester up to 36 weeks' gestation.
cross-section timing: Measurements were performed at 28-30 weeks, 31-33 weeks, and 34-36 weeks' gestation.
gest_age: Participants were studied from 28-36 weeks' gestation, with diagnostic criteria applied at 34-36 weeks.
